description: NYC Ferry Ridership is a dataset listed in City of New York open data portal (data.cityofnewyork.us), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of New York. This dataset includes information on hourly NYC Ferry boardings by date, route, direction, ferry landing, and day of week. 'Boardings' are the total number of people who boarded a vessel during the time period in question. This data forms the basis of internal NYC Ferry ridership tasks to guide service planning. Coverage: New York City. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are nycedc, transit, ridership, nyc ferry, citywide. The table has 7 columns. Attribution on the portal: New York City Economic Development Corporation (EDC). The portal shows 2026-09-17 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofnewyork-us-portal.
